messages:
maya: quick midshift check — did the kernel microbatch PR land to canary? i ran a short perf sweep and saw a ~12% latency bump at ~1k tokens on p4d-canary. anyone else see that?
liam: saw same on two runs, looks like slot allocator is hitting a contention path when batch_size > 48. attaching quick numbers: avg p95 from 220ms -> 248ms.
priya: thanks for the run! i added a logging flag to the allocator in #1234, can you enable on canary and repro? config to flip: `allocator.batch_slot_limit=48 -> 64`
ben: left review on #1234 — main concern is edge case when slot stealing occurs during long sequences. added a test suggestion.
carmen: KV cache hit-rate seemed fine during your run? i saw drop from 88% -> 81% for that workload, might explain token-level variance.
liam: good catch — kv-prefetch window got smaller after the microbatch change, i'm going to try increasing prefetch by 25% and re-run.
maya: @liam sounds good. also pinging @ben for quick CR so we can iterate fast. rough plan: liam toggle prefetch, enable allocator logging, run 3 sweeps, post numbers here.
priya: logging flag: `--alloc-debug=contention,metrics` — that'll add ~5% overhead but gives stack traces. start one run with it and one without.
deploy-bot: deployment started: canary/group-batch-202... -> p4d-canary (id: dpl-7890). ETA ~4m.
ben: i'll try to review in next 30m, if i'm blocked tag me and i'll triage.
maya: blockers: none aside from waiting on liam/ben. today: validate microbatch perf, iterate on allocator PR, collect KV hit traces, update canary telemetry dashboard.
carmen: FYI i'll snapshot KV heatmap at 1755551400 and share. might give insight into eviction spikes.
liam: started sweep 1 with `batch_slot_limit=64` + prefetch +25%, alloc logging on. will post results in ~8m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maya: perfect. thanks team :thumbsup:
